blocks.text: Eviction Cleanout FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Eviction Cleanout Services in Toronto

items.q: Do I need to move the items outside before your crew arrives?
a: No. Our crew handles the heavy lifting. We can remove eligible items from inside the property and carry them to our truck, so you don’t have to move heavy furniture or appliances yourself.

items.q: How much does an eviction cleanout cost in Toronto?
a: Pricing depends on the volume of items, the type of materials, and the difficulty of removal. Live Junk Free offers upfront pricing, with eviction cleanouts starting at $125.

items.q: Can you handle cleanouts for multiple rental units?
a: Yes. We can handle larger cleanout projects involving multiple units or apartment buildings. Volume pricing may be available for larger jobs and multi-unit properties.

items.q: Do you provide eviction cleanouts for property managers?
a: Yes. Property managers and landlords can use our eviction cleanout services to quickly clear abandoned belongings between tenants. We can also assist with recurring property turnover cleanouts.

items.q: Do you clean the property after removing the junk?
a: We tidy the area after the removal and sweep the space so it is left in a cleaner condition. Our goal is to leave the property ready for the next stage of the turnover process.
